messages:
Maya - Growth: Kicking off the 'Symphony' experiment — we want to orchestrate launch posts, a short webinar, and PLG credit hooks. Goal: improve 7-day activation (first meaningful generate) and reduce $/activated-user. :drum: :rocket:

Ollie - Marketing: Love the name. Quick q — do we prioritize testing credit amount or onboarding messaging first?

Priya - Content: I can draft three headline variants + microcopy for email/webinar landing. Timeline? I can have drafts by Tue.

Jonah - Product: Product note — let's add a 'Starter prompts' carousel on signup and pre-fill a prompt pack for arms that get the bonus. Need a feature flag for rollout.

Sam - Analytics: Proposed experimental setup: 3 arms. A = baseline (50 credits), B = 200 credits + prompt pack, C = 50 credits + proactive onboarding nudge (in-app chat). Cohort tag = plg_symphony_2760. Primary metric: 7d_activation_rate. Secondary: time_to_first_generate, tokens_used_7d.

Sam - Analytics: Config snippet:```json
{
  "experiment": "plg_symphony_2760009876",
  "arms": ["baseline_50", "bonus_200_pack", "50_plus_nudge"],
  "primary_metric": "7d_activation_rate",
  "secondary": ["time_to_first_generate", "tokens_used_7d"]
}
```

Maya - Growth: Owners: Ollie -> launch posts & webinar comms; Priya -> copy & prompt content; Jonah -> product changes/flag; Sam -> analytics/dashboards. @deploy-bot please schedule feature-flag rollout on 2026-04-07.

deploy-bot: scheduled feature flag rollout for plg_symphony_2760009876 at 2026-04-07T16:00Z. :white_check_mark:

Ollie - Marketing: I'll draft the social + landing one-pager for sales. Webinar angle: 'From zero-to-value with Redwood: build and ship in 30 minutes' — demo prompt pack + credits to drive first generate.

Priya - Content: Email subject options to start with: 1) 'Get 200 free credits + ready-to-use prompts' 2) 'Your Redwood starter kit: prompts + credits' 3) 'Ship AI features faster — prompts inside'

Sam - Analytics: Instrumentation checklist: utm_source=plg_symphony, create cohort tag 'symphony_signup', funnel events: signup -> first_generate -> save_prompt. I'll prep dashboards and QA tests.

Maya - Growth: Decision checkpoint Friday EOD. For landing hero test, keep it narrow: carousel vs single CTA. No more than two variants for hero.

Jonah - Product: Implementation detail — prompt pack 'starter_v1' will be a static JSON artifact attached to account metadata. Use the feature flag to toggle visibility; ensure cache invalidation for existing sessions.

Priya - Content: Can we repurpose assets from the last 'ignite labs' webinar? I'll audit and adapt where possible to keep design consistent.

Ollie - Marketing: Need landing + webinar registration page by Wed. I'll loop in design. Also will write a staged social calendar for launch week.

Sam - Analytics: I'll add instrumentation to staging now. Ping me when builds are up for QA.

Maya - Growth: Quick todo summary: Ollie -> landing + webinar + social; Priya -> copy + prompt pack drafts; Jonah -> flag + carousel; Sam -> dashboards + events; deploy-bot -> schedule. Reply with a ✅ on your line when you take ownership.

Ollie - Marketing: ✅

Priya - Content: ✅

Jonah - Product: ✅

Sam - Analytics: ✅

Maya - Growth: I'll run a 30m sync Mon 09:30 PT to align on CTA and final copy. Calendar invite incoming. :calendar:
